name: 01-mae-mfe-all-families
description: Step 1 (line-touch-mae-futures v2): MAE/MFE at every touch of OH/OL, OC and HL p50/p75/p90, by line group and rung, forecast lines vs the x0.85 / x1.15 placebo ladders.

name: 02-stacks
description: Step 2: lines close together. A touch is stacked if another line sits within 5 ticks; lone vs stacked medians in sigma and back-wins. Try --set select.stack.unit=sigma --set select.stack.width=0.05.

name: 03-better-level-race
description: Step 3 (v3): better level (outermost line of a 5-tick stack) and the race: stop = median 60m MAE, target = median 60m MFE of the same set, first passage over 60 one-minute bars, gross. Swap select.set to all / first / better_first.

name: 04-vwap-fade
description: Step 4 (futures-exhaustion-vwap baseline): fade every touch (one per bar and side, the outermost line) to the session VWAP frozen at the bar before the touch, 0.25 sigma stop, held to 22:00 London, 2 ticks + $4 cost. Swap trade.target.anchor to globex or rth.

name: 05-vwap-fade-mae-stop
description: Step 5 (2026-11-18 check): the VWAP fade with test 3's median 60m MAE as the stop (fitted on all forecast-line touches) instead of 0.25 sigma. Try stop.horizon=eod or stop.units=sigma with fit=discovery.
